items.title_en: New EIP: Storage Roots in Block Access Lists
items.note_en: (CPerezz), submitted as EIP-8268; discussion thread, 15:29: every BAL entry that records state modifications carries the post-block storage trie root, so partially stateful nodes can verify the state root without holding full storage tries.

keywords_en: ACDE #237 proposes EIP-8182 private transfers for Hegotá
EIP-8037 improves gas accounting for 7702 authorizations
EIP-8268 storage roots in block access lists
summary_en: On ACDE #237, EIP-8182 private ETH and ERC-20 transfers, EIP-8188 state tiering by write age and EIP-4758 deactivate SELFDESTRUCT were proposed as Hegotá non-headliners. rjl493456442 submitted an EIP-8037 change that charges 7702 authorization state gas by net state change. CPerezz submitted EIP-8268, attaching storage roots to block access lists. EIP-7954 raised the contract code limit to 64KiB, and it was merged.
